resolutions: The amended plan removes the graph from binding inputs and states that it is historical exploration only. The recorded decomposition, task plans, Git patch inventory, and immutable preparation files are the sole ownership authority; the obsolete 18-path row cannot override the recorded 23-path remediation expectation.

The recovery now retains Decision 0066: selected proof validates first, invalid or stale proof leaves caller/authoritative/snapshot bytes unchanged, and a still-fresh legacy stamp converts in place only after the shared current-delta predicate passes. Portable later migrates fixed review layouts before runtime fallback removal.

The later user instruction withdraws the unaccepted draft-only Wait choice. The amended plan cites accepted Decision 0064 for causal pause plus independently owned dependency-ready continuation, while coordinator transfer separately waits. The historical round is retained only because the incumbent recorder requires its exact ledger provenance and grants no contrary authority.

The amended plan mirrors the installed helper: traverse provider passes in order, retain the first exact NFC-path/integer-line/category/normalized-tagged-title key, apply the exact chunk label and 2,000-character body bound, require the whole synthesized list, leave later duplicates raw-only, refuse source attribution on the plain-source path, and add a real duplicate-across-chunks fixture.

The canonical Forge byte producer is _combined_prompt(task). Forge writes those exact UTF-8 bytes once to the task combined brief, hashes/counts that file, and passes it as --prompt-file. Helper identity, dataset hash, commit, delta, and token separately bind other controlled inputs; helper-owned rendering is expressly outside the byte claim.

The schema uses origin-specific fields. Combined/rejection preserve real autoreview run, brief, helper, input, and raw-result provenance. Upgrade uses generated_by=upgrade, exact copied sealed lens payloads, inventory/source hashes, and marker identity, and forbids fabricated helper/prompt/raw/run/brief fields. Active fixed proof receives a fresh combined review.

QUALITY-BASELINE now owns both .github/workflows/factory-scaffold.yml and .github/workflows/harness-health.yml default-branch/pull-request triggers, plus pr-ticket-check and the shared pinned quality runner, before client rollout.

NATIVE-LIFECYCLE owns one shared codex_runtime logger with the constitution's exact JSON fields and one Local console transport. Human stderr is operator UI and task JSONL is recorder-controlled evidence, neither another logger transport; the exception boundary adds one sanitized trace and correlated metric.

The Changed Docs contract and decomposition assign Lean, Native lifecycle, Shared, Portable, Format, and Quality the relevant workflow/factory/quality/roles/getting-started/architecture updates in the same owning task and PR before each enduring boundary ships.
